title: brachystylus cristatus
intro: Brachystylus cristatus, commonly known as the African boxwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is a shrub or small tree that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The health benefits of Brachystylus cristatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are limonene, pinene, and other essential oils that are present in the plant's leaves, bark, and roots.
